name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with a 1px outer shadow. This meets WCAG AAA for focus visibility while keeping the ring thick enough for touch and low-vision users to spot. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but that’s the point: focus rings must be unmistakable.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 7:1 fails on high-DPI screens where pixels blur—users lose the ring entirely. A 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a 2px outer shadow keeps visibility sharp on all screens while still meeting WCAG AA for focus visibility. Test both on a 4K display at 200% zoom to settle it.
